name: Fancy Pickled Eggs
description: A variation of pickled eggs with beets, giving them a distinctive purple color and sweet flavor.

recipeInstructions.text: In an enamel or stainless steel saucepan, combine all ingredients except eggs and onion rings.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large glass jar, alternate layers of eggs, beets, and onion rings.
Pour the heated liquid into the jar, ensuring all layers are covered.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Will keep in the fridge for 2 weeks.

keywords: pickled eggs, beets, appetizer, purple eggs

_similar.name: Plain Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: A simple recipe for pickled eggs with a tangy cider vinegar brine and sliced onions.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except eggs and onion rings in a stainless steel or enamel pot.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large jar, alternate layers of eggs and onion rings.
Pour the heated liquid over the eggs and onions, ensuring all are covered.
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. Will keep in the fridge for 2 weeks.

_similar.name: Pickled Eggs
_similar.description: Tangy pickled eggs made with vinegar, mustard, and spices, perfect for snacking or as a side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the vinegar, water, mustard, salt, pepper, and onion pieces in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the hard-boiled eggs.
Let the eggs stand in the pickling liquid for 5 days before serving.

_similar.keywords: pickled eggs, tangy snack, preserved eggs

_similar.name: Tossed Berry-Mandarin Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing mixed greens salad with strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion, and bacon, topped with a homemade honey-cider dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 medium sweet onion, sliced and separated into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine sugar, cider vinegar, honey, lemon juice, paprika, mustard, grated onion, celery seed, and salt.
Microwave uncovered on high for 1½ to 2 minutes, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Whisk in vegetable oil until well combined. Refrigerate until chilled.
In a large serving bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion rings, toasted almonds, and crumbled bacon.
Drizzle the chilled dressing over the salad and gently toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: fruit salad, mixed greens, strawberry, mandarin orange, bacon

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad

_similar.name: Rumaki
_similar.description: Classic rumaki appetizer featuring bacon-wrapped water chestnuts baked in a ketchup and brown sugar glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the pound of bacon in half.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Bake at 350°F for ½ hour.
Drain grease.
Mix ketchup and brown sugar.
Pour mixture over chestnuts and bake for another ½ hour.
